events.summary: Mercury added wire drawdowns that let payroll providers such as Sequoia and Gusto withdraw funds directly from eligible Mercury accounts.
events.headline: Authorize wire drawdowns for payroll

events.summary: The Mercury API added real-time payments via the realTimePayment payment method, with funds arriving in seconds around the clock for eligible Business and Personal accounts.
events.headline: Send real-time payments with the Mercury API

events.summary: Customers can connect multiple Mercury accounts, move money between eligible accounts, create auto-transfer rules, and schedule recurring external transfers.
events.headline: All your accounts, connected

events.summary: Mercury made faster priority support available to Plus and Pro customers while retaining 24/7 support for all customers.
events.headline: Priority Support added to Plus and Pro

events.summary: Customers can ask ChatGPT or Claude to move money, pay recipients, or categorize transactions, with approval required before actions execute.
events.headline: Mercury account actions from ChatGPT and Claude

events.summary: Mercury launched payroll for W-2 employees and 1099 contractors, with benefits, 401(k) options, tax and compliance handling, and coverage in all 50 states.
events.headline: Mercury Payroll launches
